title: TD2 Comms: Government
summary: A collection of 13 comms from The Division universe, scraped from the Fandom wiki hub page. 13 entries include full audio transcripts; 11 have known map locations.

claims.text: Comm "Black Friday Briefing": First POTUS briefing on the outbreak where he receives privileged information, hinting at the scope of the disaster (Location: White House (1744, 2765))

Comm "UN Briefing": President Mendez meets with the UN to ascertain the effects of Green Poison around the globe (Location: Southwest (761, 3550))
Comm "Keener Briefing": Meeting to discuss Keener, the Rogue Agents in NYC, and activating the second wave (Location: Southwest (699, 3798))
Comm "Possible Subterfuge": Former Vice President Mendez, after being sworn in as POTUS, shares his suspicions with Andrew Ellis (Location: White House (1895, 2787))
Comm "Essential Evacuation": Evacuation of key government staff from Washington (Location: West Potomac Park (1177, 2836))
Comm "Black Box": Air Force One black box tape (Location: East Mall (1036, 4787))
